title: When ACE flies, my brain crashes
content: Seen ACE pop +40% and instantly thought I’d ride the rocket. 3 AM later I’m staring at a 1‑minute chart like it’s a Netflix series—plot twist: I’m still on the loading screen.
lesson: Don’t let a single meme‑coin surge dictate your leverage; set stop‑losses before the hype hits the fan.
question: Who else chased the ACE hype and ended up binge‑watching candles? Be honest 👇
